tagline: An independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company focused on the Delaware Basin.
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex is the primary growth lever in shale E&P, directly driving future production and capacity in the Delaware Basin.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on drilling, completions, and fixed assets.
kpis.description: Total capex reaches $2.3 Bn in 2025, up from $1.8 Bn in 2024, supported by acquisitions and increased activity in the Delaware Basin.
kpis.signal: Capex rising significantly to support production growth

kpis.name: Oil Equivalent Production
kpis.explanation: Total volume of oil, gas, and condensate produced, converted to barrels of oil equivalent.
kpis.description: Oil equivalent production reaches 285.6 MMBoe in 2025, up 38.0 MMBoe from 2024 (247.6 MMBoe).
kpis.signal: Significant production growth driven by acquisitions

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reaches $4.0 Bn in 2025, up $1.2 Bn from 2024 ($2.8 Bn), driven by higher production and natural gas prices.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in cash flow despite lower oil prices

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reaches $1.7 Bn in 2025, up $596 million from 2024 ($1.1 Bn).
kpis.signal: Net income growing strongly reflecting positive price mix impact

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per share held.
kpis.description: The quarterly dividend was increased to $0.22 per share in February 2025, from $0.21 previously.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase reflecting strong balance sheet and cash flow generation

kpis.name: Available Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Sum of available cash and undrawn commitments under revolving credit facility.
kpis.description: Total liquidity of $2.1 Bn as of December 31, 2025, consisting of $114 million in cash and $2.0 Bn of available credit capacity.
kpis.signal: Strong liquidity despite acquisitions and debt repayments

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $7.645 Bn in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $2.452 Bn in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.22 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.682 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 39.7% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Average Realized Natural Gas Price
kpis.explanation: Average price realized by the company for natural gas sold.
kpis.description: Average realized gas price reaches $2.47 per Mcf in 2025, up 41% from $1.75 per Mcf in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in natural gas prices in 2025

kpis.name: Average Realized Oil Price
kpis.explanation: Average price realized by the company for crude oil sold.
kpis.description: Average realized oil price stands at $64.35 per barrel in 2025, down 13% from $74.22 per barrel in 2024.
kpis.signal: Decline in oil prices in 2025 despite sustained overall demand

risks.title: Failure or delay of the merger with Devon
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned first and repeated multiple times. The language is strong (may not be completed at all). The merger is a strategic priority; its failure would have existential consequences.

risks.title: Business disruptions during the merger
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned multiple times with concerning language (disruptions, uncertainty, adversely affect). Recurring risk during the merger period. Direct impact on employee and commercial partner retention.

risks.title: Difficult integration of the two companies
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned with serious consequences (loss of key employees, high costs, delays). Strong language: could result in, unforeseen expenses.

risks.title: Commodity price declines
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a fundamental risk in the Business and Operational Risks section. Very strong language (material adverse impact, substantial or extended decline). History of volatility emphasized.

risks.title: Litigation related to the merger
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of litigation risks (class actions, derivative actions). Preventive but serious language (substantial costs, injunction). New risk arising from the merger announcement.

risks.title: High merger-related costs
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of significant costs (financial advisors, legal, employee-related fees). These costs are incurred even if the merger fails. Direct impact on cash flow.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding future dividends
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned with cautious language (uncertain, discretion of the Board). Less intense than others, but important for income investors.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CTRA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
